concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-dispute-remove-evidence-node]] - Braintree Node.js removal of one evidence item by dispute and evidence IDs while the dispute is `Open`, restricted to merchants with Control Panel dispute access and distinct from evidence submission or finalization
warnings: Keep removal limited to disputes with status `Open` and preserve both required example identifiers: dispute ID and evidence ID.
Keep API availability qualified to merchants who can access disputes in the Braintree Control Panel.
Do not infer that removal submits remaining evidence, finalizes the dispute, or changes dispute status; those actions and effects are not stated by this page.
Treat the linked Dispute response page as navigation only; this source does not establish its unread full status schema or broader dispute lifecycle.
